openingMessages.text: 🚨 Production is down. Dashboard returning 500s for all enterprise accounts.
How long has this been down??
About 20 minutes. Looks like the SSO integration is causing a database deadlock.
@channel I'm getting calls from enterprise clients. What is happening right now.
The auth layer changes from last sprint made this significantly worse than it needed to be. Just so everyone knows.
I'm just here. I don't know what any of this means. Is there anything I can do?

choices.label: Hotfix it, ship now
choices.subtext: Push a fix directly to production. Fast.
choices.tagline: Put out the fire. Left some embers.

followUpMessages.text: Hotfix is live. We're back up. 28 minutes total downtime.
Status page updated. Notifying clients now.
I left a comment in the code. It says 'DO NOT TOUCH THIS'. Please respect that.

choices.label: Roll back
choices.subtext: Revert to the last stable build.

followUpMessages.text: Rollback complete. Enterprise accounts are restored.
We lost 30 minutes. Enterprise clients are going to notice the SSO regression.
The alternative was staying down longer. We made the right call.

choices.label: Fix it and communicate
choices.subtext: Keep clients updated while fixing the root cause.

followUpMessages.text: Status page updated with timeline. Clients are getting proactive comms.
Root cause patched. 45-minute outage but this deadlock pattern is gone permanently.
Enterprise clients actually appreciated the transparency. That's... not what I expected.
